    wb.append({"id": w["id"], "xmin": xmin, "ymin": ymin, "xmax": xmax, "ymax": ymax})

for i in range(len(wb)):
    for j in range(i+1, len(wb)):
        a = wb[i]; b = wb[j]
        oxmin = a["xmin"] if a["xmin"]>b["xmin"] else b["xmin"]
        oxmax = a["xmax"] if a["xmax"]<b["xmax"] else b["xmax"]
        oymin = a["ymin"] if a["ymin"]>b["ymin"] else b["ymin"]
        oymax = a["ymax"] if a["ymax"]<b["ymax"] else b["ymax"]
        if oxmin <= oxmax and oymin <= oymax:
            ix = (oxmin + oxmax) / 2.0
            iy = (oymin + oymax) / 2.0
            # add if not near existing
            found = False
            for p in ips:
                dx = p[0]-ix; dy = p[1]-iy

        if mind2 == None or d2 < mind2:

    if mind2 != None and mind2 <= 4.0:  # within 2 m squared
        close_cols.append(c["id"])
